description:
Buy a TV pass for 2 devices: 0.10 USDC for 30 days, 0.29 for 90 or 0.99 for 365.
No automatic renewal. A 402 uses x402 on Base; repeat the same call with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1). The shared ledger records the attempt, payment and entitlement. The code identifies the TV device, with the network as fallback. A verified payer account groups its devices. A full account receives an authorization code before payment. Reusing the receipt does not buy another pass.

codigo.description: Six digits shown in the TV notice; valid for ten minutes.

plano.description: The pass period; without it, 30 days.
